First, I'll analyze the SVG path coordinates to determine the shape it draws.  

The path is:  
M 41.10,39.10  
L 37.66,20.53  
L 49.73,18.29  
L 59.87,21.21  
M 59.87,21.21  
L 65.24,34.62  
L 49.95,55.71  
L 29.03,41.34  
L 41.10,39.10  

The first M starts at (41.10,39.10), then lines to (37.66,20.53), then to (49.73,18.29), then to (59.87,21.21).  
Then there's a new M at (59.87,21.21) — this means the pen lifts and starts a new subpath at the same point — so it's a continuous path but described in two segments.  

Let's list all unique vertices in order:  
1. (41.10,39.10)  
2. (37.66,20.53)  
3. (49.73,18.29)  
4. (59.87,21.21)  
5. (65.24,34.62)  
6. (49.95,55.71)  
7. (29.03,41.34)  
8. back to (41.10,39.10)  

That's 7 distinct points before returning to the start, so the polygon has 7 sides.  

A 7-sided polygon is a heptagon.  

Final answer: (B)
